# Little Farm Story — Project Status (Phase 0 → Phase 7)

An original Android portrait (9:16) 3D casual farming simulator, built in Unity 6000.5.9f1 / URP 17.5.0. Everything below is what actually exists on disk and has been verified — either by offline compile against Unity's own Roslyn, or by scripted Play Mode tests whose result files are checked into `Documentation/`. This is written so the next phase can be scoped against real, checked state rather than memory.

**The whole world is code-generated.** `Assets/_Game/Scenes/Farm_Prototype.unity` is a build product regenerated by `FarmPrototypeBuilder` (menu: `Little Farm Story → Rebuild Farm Scene`). There is no external art — every mesh, material, icon and UI panel is procedural.

---

## 1. Phase-by-phase history

| Phase | What it delivered |
|---|---|
| **0 / 1** | Project audit (`PROJECT_AUDIT.md`), architecture decisions (no god-object GameManager, no per-frame `FindObjectOfType`, Input System over legacy Input), playable farm prototype: movement, camera, a plot you could till. |
| **2** | Real farming system: `FarmGrid`/`FarmPlot` state machine, `CropDefinition` data, growth ticking. |
| **3** | Visual foundation: procedural mesh library (`StylizedMeshLibrary`) with provable-correct winding, material palette, mobile render settings. |
| **4A** | Production environment art: farmhouse, fields, coop, barn, market plaza, paths, terrain dressing — the whole world's layout. |
| **4B** | Segmented character rigs: farmer (7 renderers, `FarmerLimbAnimator`), chicken (4 renderers, 2 plumage variants), cow (7 renderers) — all animatable, `AnimalIdleAnimator` for idle motion. |
| **5** | Animal gameplay core: hunger, happiness, production (egg/milk), habitats, wandering, feeding/collecting through the existing interaction system. |
| **5A** | Runtime stabilization: fixed a genuine builder-ordering bug (assets authored before `NewScene()` were silently "fake-null"), added `VerifyBuild` self-checks, added the scripted `GameplayLoopTest` Play Mode harness. |
| **6** | Full UI/HUD replacement: safe-area handling, TextMeshPro typography, procedural icon set, contextual action button, feedback toast queue, storage sheet — all data-bound, no hardcoded values. |
| **7** | Economy: coins, a shop at the Market, buying seeds, selling crops — described in full below. |

---

## 2. What's actually implemented, system by system

### Player & world
- **Movement** — `PlayerController` (acceleration-based, camera-relative), `CharacterController`, joystick + keyboard input via `PlayerInputProvider`/`IMoveInputSource`.
- **Camera** — `FarmCameraController`, fixed near-isometric framing tuned for portrait.
- **Interaction** — `InteractionController` (proximity scan, priority-then-distance focus resolution), `IInteractable`/`InteractableBase` contract used by every interactable in the game (plots, animals, the market). Priority bands: Decoration 0 < Area 5 < Production 10 < Plot 25 < Animal 30.
- **World landmarks** — `FarmLandmark` (generic, still a placeholder for Home/Production/Field) and `MarketInteractable` (the one landmark with real behaviour — opens the shop).

### Farming
- `FarmGrid` (owns a field, centrally ticks only its growing plots — one `Update` per field, not per plot) / `FarmPlot` (owns its own state machine: Empty → Tilled → Planted/Growing → ReadyToHarvest → Empty).
- `CropDefinition` (ScriptableObject: seed/harvest item ids, growth stages, seconds per stage, sell value, stage-visual prefabs). Three crops authored: **Wheat**, **Tomato**, **Corn** — only Wheat is currently in the shop.
- Crop visuals generated per-stage by `CropVisualBuilder`, combined into single renderers.
- Growth is dev-accelerated in the Editor only (`FarmingSettings.developmentGrowthMultiplier = 4`) — ships at authored pace on device.

### Animals
- `AnimalController` (per-instance state), `AnimalNeeds` (hunger/happiness), `AnimalProduction` (Dormant → Producing → Ready → Dormant, one cycle per feed, no duplicate collection possible), `AnimalMovement` (bounded wandering), `AnimalHabitat` (capacity + centralized simulation tick, one `Update` per habitat), `AnimalInteraction` (feed/collect through the same interaction system as everything else).
- `AnimalDefinition` data for **Chicken** (feeds on wheat → eggs) and **Cow** (feeds on corn → milk). `AnimalDefinition` also carries a `produceSellValue` field for future egg/milk pricing — present but deliberately unset and unused this phase.
- Visual variants: `Chicken_A`/`Chicken_B` (two plumage colours, same mesh), `Cow`.

### Economy (Phase 7 — the newest system)
- **`CurrencyWallet`** — a typed currency on the Player (not folded into `PlayerInventory`), starting balance 100, `TrySpendCoins`/`AddCoins`/`CanAfford`/`GetBalance`, balance can never go negative, fires `BalanceChanged`/`BalanceDelta`.
- **`EconomyManager`** — the single transaction authority. `Purchase`/`Sell` (by item or by id), `CanPurchase`/`CanSell` for UI pre-checks. Every transaction is atomic (coins and items never move independently of each other; a failed inventory-add refunds spent coins) and duplicate-guarded (an identical transaction repeated within a configurable window — default 0.35s — is refused, defending against double-taps at the API level, not just by disabling a button).
- **`ShopDefinition`/`ShopItemDefinition`** — data-driven catalogue. One item can be purchasable, sellable, both, or neither, each with its own price, min/max quantity and quantity step. Currently two entries: **Wheat Seeds** (buy 2 coins) and **Wheat** (sell 4 coins).
- **`ShopPanel`/`ShopBuyCard`/`ShopSellRow`** — the shop UI. Genuinely freezes the world while open (disables the real `PlayerController` and `InteractionController` components, not just a visual overlay) and restores them on close. Buy card has a working quantity stepper; sell row has Sell 1 / Sell 5 / Sell All, each individually enabled/disabled based on what's actually sellable.
- **`TransactionResult`/`TransactionOutcome`** — 20-value result enum (mirrors the existing `FarmActionResult`/`AnimalActionResult` pattern) so every refusal has a specific, loggable reason.

### UI (Phase 6)
- One canvas, `SafeAreaPanel` (insets to the device safe area), TextMeshPro throughout with a resolved-and-verified font (no blank-label risk), a semantic colour palette (`UiPalette`), a procedural SDF-painted icon set (16 icons) — all placeholders for future hand-authored art, but structurally complete (swap a PNG, no code change).
- `HudController` is the single binding point between gameplay and the HUD: coins from `CurrencyWallet.BalanceChanged`, resources from `PlayerInventory.Changed`, the contextual action label from `InteractionController.FocusChanged` (the UI never invents wording — it displays the interactable's own label verbatim), feedback from `ActionFeedbackChannel.MessagePosted` through a real toast queue.
- Storage sheet (all carried resources) and Shop panel are both slide-up modals sharing the same recipe.

### Inventory & items
- **One** `PlayerInventory` instance in the whole game (id-keyed, quantities can't go negative, `Changed` event) — confirmed by direct scene-file inspection that farming, animals, the economy and the HUD all reference the exact same instance, not parallel copies.
- `ItemIds` — the naming convention (`seed_<crop>`, `<crop>`, `egg`, `milk`) so no system ever hardcodes a string an item might drift from.

### Tooling (this is a lot of what makes the project trustworthy)
- **`FarmPrototypeBuilder`** — the one-click scene generator, with `VerifyBuild` self-checks that fail the build loudly (not silently) if wiring is wrong: crop visuals, HUD labels, animal habitats, the shop catalogue, and — as of this phase — that the market's shop-panel reference, the HUD's wallet/inventory references, and the economy manager's wallet/inventory/shop references all point at the exact real instances, not stray duplicates.
- **`GameplayLoopTest`** (`Little Farm Story → Run Gameplay Loop Test`) — a scripted Play Mode harness driving the *real* interaction chain (proximity scan → focus → `Interact()` → state change), covering the full farming and animal loops.
- **`Little Farm Story → Run Phase 7 Runtime Verification`** — a second scripted Play Mode suite specifically for the shop: opens it, clicks the real Plus/Buy/Sell buttons, verifies coins and inventory against the live components, tests an insufficient-funds refusal and a sell-at-zero refusal, confirms the world genuinely re-enables after closing, and smoke-tests that farming/chicken/cow still work afterward. **Last run: 20/20 steps passed.**
- **EditMode economy tests** (`Little Farm Story → Run Economy Tests`) — 23 NUnit tests against `CurrencyWallet`/`EconomyManager` directly (starting balance, exact-cost purchases, insufficient funds, overselling, negative/zero quantities, and five separate rapid-repeated-call scenarios proving atomicity). **Last run: 23/23 passed.**
- Both test suites write their results to `Documentation/ECONOMY_TEST_RESULTS.md` and `Documentation/RUNTIME_TEST_RESULTS.md` — real, re-checkable evidence, not narrated claims.

## 3. Explicitly NOT implemented (by instruction, every phase so far)

Save/Load, cloud save, a market beyond wheat seeds/wheat, egg or milk selling (the data slot exists, the price doesn't), production machines (processing raw goods into higher-value goods), orders/quests, NPC economy, vehicles, progression/XP (the HUD shows a level+XP bar, but it's a static placeholder — no system feeds it), monetization (ads/IAP), multiplayer, full hand-authored art (everything is procedural placeholder geometry and icons, explicitly documented as such in `ART_ASSET_SPEC_*.md`).

## 4. Known rough edges worth knowing about

- Coins/level/XP progression has no real system behind the level+XP display — it's cosmetic.
- `FarmLandmark` (Home, Production zone, Field signage) are still inert placeholders that log and do nothing.
- Animal produce (egg/milk) cannot be sold — `AnimalDefinition.HasProduceSellValue` is asserted false by `VerifyBuild` on purpose, so this can't get half-enabled by accident.
- Only Wheat is purchasable/sellable in the shop; Tomato and Corn exist as crops but have no shop presence yet. Adding one is "author a `ShopItemDefinition` and add it to `ShopDefinition`" — no code branch needed anywhere, this was a deliberate design goal.
- No persistence: closing the Editor/game loses all progress. `AnimalSnapshot`/`FarmPlotSnapshot` structs already exist as save-system prep, but no `SaveManager` exists.

---

## 5. Natural next-phase candidates

Not a recommendation, just what the current architecture makes cheapest to build next, in the order the existing hooks make easiest:

1. **Expand the shop catalogue** (corn/tomato seeds + produce) — almost zero new code, just new `ShopItemDefinition` assets.
2. **Egg/milk pricing** — the `AnimalDefinition.produceSellValue` slot and the shop's per-item architecture are already there; this is authoring + un-asserting the `VerifyBuild` guard.
3. **Save/Load** — the snapshot structs already exist for plots and animals; the wallet and inventory would need equivalent snapshot/restore methods (both already have the right shape — `CurrencyWallet.RestoreBalance`, `PlayerInventory.All`).
4. **Progression (coins earned → level/XP)** — the HUD display exists; only the source system is missing.
5. **A second habitat/animal, or a second crop in active rotation** — proves the data-driven claims scale past the first instance of each.

Everything above is inference from what's already built, not a plan — tell me which direction and I'll audit and scope it properly before writing anything.
